title: Conditions Clearing Is the Slowest Part of the Loan, and the Best Place to Put an AI Agent
summary: The gap between conditional approval and clear-to-close is where cycle time goes to die. How an AI processing agent clears conditions inside the LOS without breaking the Reg B incompleteness clock or the TRID redisclosure rules.
